description: Returns the figures of one table of Geostat for a selection: value codes, or the last values, for each dimension. A dimension with no selection takes every value. Selects at most 1000 cells. An unpublished figure is null. The title of the table names the unit. Data from Geostat.

code.description: The code of a table, from stats_search_tables.

language.description: The language of the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

selection.description: The values of each dimension. A dimension that this list omits takes every value.

dimension.description: The code of a dimension, from stats_get_table.

last.description: The count of the last values of the dimension, the newest for a time dimension.

values.description: The codes of the values. Give values or last, not both.

name: stats_get_cells

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the figures, RFC 3339.

figure.description: The figure as a decimal string, or null when Geostat did not publish it.

values.description: The text of the value of the cell on each dimension, in the order of dimensions.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of each cell, in the order of the values of a cell.

code.description: The code of the dimension, for a selection.
The code of the value, for a selection.

source.description: The source of the data: Geostat.

stale.description: True when Geostat did not answer and the server returns figures it read before.

table.description: The table, with no dimension values.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the table, RFC 3339.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the table, each with its values in the order of Geostat.

code.description: The code of the dimension, for a selection.
The code of the value, for a selection.

folder.description: The folder path of the table, from the subject down, as in the code. The same in both languages.

source.description: The source of the data: Geostat.

stale.description: True when Geostat did not answer and the server returns a table it read before.

title.description: The title of the table. It often names the unit.

updated.description: The date on which Geostat last changed the table, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: Get the figures of a statistical table
